# Third-party reruns

External reruns of a card go here as `<exp_id>__<who>.md`, using the same null-card
schema (`../null_card.schema.json`) plus a hardware string and the delta to the reference
card. A failed replication is added, never hidden, with `verdict: REPLICATION-FAILED` and
the observed delta. If a third-party rerun overturns a published claim, the original card
is marked SUPERSEDED with a link to the rerun, never deleted. The archive of disagreement
is part of the credibility, not a threat to it. Form per BLACKHOLE.md: no em dashes.

(No third-party cards yet.)
